_provenance.status: PROVISIONAL — no digital-memorial service or contract exists (docs/06-cultural-digital-memorial/digital-memorial.md, blueprint §22–23)
note: WHAT THIS IS: the recorded state of the PUBLIC digital-memorial surface (F-04). The service that will store and serve memorials is not built and no contract freezes its shape, so this file records the honest starting state — nothing is published, and no memorial may be invented to make the screens look alive.

THE EMPTY `consents` LIST IS THE FACT, not an omission. A loved one is published only when their family turns ONE switch on (app/(family)/client/memorials/page.tsx); every field choice beside that switch defaults OFF, so a name-only memorial is a complete page and no birth or death date is ever required.

THE RULES ARE CODE, NOT DATA: the switch and the per-field choices live in lib/memorials.ts; the durable store is lib/api-client/memorial-store.ts (an append-only journal under MEMORIAL_STORE_PATH, else .data/family-memorials.json); the public reader lib/api-client/memorials.ts builds a public shape ONLY for a person whose switch is on, and drops every field the family did not choose. A record's published shape (name, the chosen years, an optional photograph, the chosen resting place) is assembled field by field there, never cast from a fixture.

The client's own public memorial search/privacy rules are still an OPEN question (docs/07-client-villa/open-questions.md — “Public memorial search/privacy rules”). The pages publish the product's guaranteed privacy floor and name that open item; they never assume an answer.

WHEN THE SERVICE LANDS: replace this seed with recorded responses and give lib/api-client/memorial-store.ts a live branch, keeping the switch / field vocabulary in lib/memorials.ts (or moving it to the contract that supersedes it — never the reverse).
